comment: Device budgets (docs/plan.md section 2, reasons and sources in docs/research/perf-goals.md). Each metric: its test and the xcresult metric that measures it (filter, scale to the unit), its perf-log column, target (the best realistic number), fail (an absolute regression guard), slack (the ratchet's noise floor, in the metric's unit) and why. Device runs fail at `fail`, or past the ratchet: more than ratchet.tolerance (or slack, whichever is larger) worse than the metric's best in the last ratchet.window passing device rows. A metric whose iterations spread more than ratchet.rsdLimit (relative standard deviation) reruns its test once. On a simulator the gate fails on a regression larger than simRegressionTolerance against the previous sim row instead.

launchMs.label: main() to first frame, responsive (ms)
launchMs.why: Apple's launch goal is 400 ms from the icon tap to the first frame, about 100 ms of it the system's, which leaves 300 ms for the app (WWDC19 423): fail there. Pre-main time is not in this interval, so a lean UIKit app reaches its first frame in about half the app's share: target 150, under today's 225.

searchFieldMs.label: main() to search field focused (ms)
searchFieldMs.why: The field takes focus before the first frame, so it shares the launch budget: Apple's 300 ms app share fails, 150 is the lean-app target (today 198).

hitchMsPerS.label: Page scroll hitch ratio (ms/s)
hitchMsPerS.why: A scroll of an ordinary page drops no frame in a perfect app, and Plain already measures 0. Apple's 2020 tiers call under 5 ms/s good and 10 critical (its current page: 10 good, 25 warning); fail at 5, the stricter line. Slack 1 ms/s: one 8 ms hitch per 8 s of scrolling.

galleryMs.label: Tabs button to gallery visibly settled (ms)
galleryMs.why: Ends when the page is within 0.5 pt of its card (TabGalleryTransition), not at Core Animation's settle, and starts at the tap (getting the gallery ready counts, since 2026-11-27). The 0.42 s spring with bounce 0.06 (2026-11-27, docs/research/perf-gallery-swipe.md) comes within 0.5 pt in ~0.47-0.50 s; was critically damped (~0.60 s). Target 610, fail 750.

swipeMs.label: Bar swipe: finger lift to page settled (ms)
swipeMs.why: From the finger lifting (tab.swipeSettle), so the test's scripted drag is left out. Ends when the page is within 0.5 pt of the neighbour and moving less than 0.5 pt a frame, plus the hand-off (tab.swipeHandoff, ~10-15 ms). The 0.28 s / bounce 0.08 spring (2026-11-27) rests in ~0.26-0.30 s on any width, the Duo's inner page included; the old 0.35 s / 0.12 spring overshot 2-3 pt there and crept back (the ~200 ms in today's 526). Target 320, fail 600.

lastTabMs.label: main() to first frame with the last tab (ms)
lastTabMs.why: The cold-launch budget, with the last tab's picture (decoded off the main thread) and the resting bar on the first frame (today 214).

focusMs.label: Address pill tap to keyboard at rest (ms)
focusMs.why: Ends at keyboardDidShow, so the system keyboard's rise is inside: 0.5 s on iOS 27.2 (the simulator's fastest runs end 1 ms after it). The best possible is that rise starting on the tap's own frame: 500 plus one 120 Hz frame, 510. Fail 600: the rise plus the 100 ms that reads as a delay (Nielsen; Apple's hang threshold).

suggestionsMs.label: Keystroke to local suggestions shown (ms)
suggestionsMs.why: A keystroke's local rows (a database read off the main thread, then one list update) should land on the next 120 Hz frame: target 8.3. RAIL keeps input handling within 50 ms so the visible response fits in 100 ms: fail 50.

linkPaintMs.label: Link tap to next page's first paint (ms)
linkPaintMs.why: A tap on a link to the next page's first contentful paint, for a small page served on the phone itself, so the network is left out and what remains is the app's navigation handling and WebKit's load, layout and paint. Target 100: the instant threshold (Nielsen; Apple's hang line). Fail 200: Core Web Vitals' 'good' interaction to next paint (INP).

galleryTabMs.label: Gallery card tap to page settled (ms)
galleryTabMs.why: The gallery's open in reverse: the same 0.42 s critically damped spring, which visibly rests (within 0.5 pt) at ~0.60 s; plus a frame, 610. Fail 750, as the gallery's open.

newTabMs.label: New Tab to keyboard at rest (ms)
newTabMs.why: Like the address bar's focus: the new tab and its field are ready on the tap's frame and the system keyboard's 0.5 s rise is the rest. Target 510, fail 600.

memoryMB.label: App memory with 10 tabs (MB)
memoryMB.why: The app process's footprint (XCTMemoryMetric's absolute physical) with ten local pages in tabs, after the gallery showed all ten cards. WebKit's own processes hold the pages and are not counted. A lean UIKit shell is ~40 MB, and ten thumbnails at 2x card size ~1.3 MB each: target 60. Fail 150, twice the simulator's reading, until device rows exist; the ratchet then holds it near its best.

heavyHitchMsPerS.label: Heavy darkened page scroll hitch ratio (ms/s)
heavyHitchMsPerS.why: A large light-only page (6,300 elements, 4,000 rules) darkened by dark pages: scrolling is composited off the main thread, so a perfect app drops nothing, target 0 (docs/research/dark-mode.md: dark pages must add no hitch). No device number yet: fail at 10, Apple's current 'good' ceiling, and the ratchet tightens it from the first passing device row.
